title: Bijectivity of the induced completion map
statement: Under the same Noetherian local hypotheses, maximal-ideal equality and residue-field bijectivity, any flat ring homomorphism between the adic completions compatible with the original local map is bijective.

proof.text: Write R and S for the maximal-adic completions. Mathlib maximalIdeal_eq_map for both completions, Ideal.map_map, compatibility hcomp and hmax give map φhat (maximalIdeal R) = maximalIdeal S. Therefore φhat is local by IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE.

Regard S as an R-algebra using φhat.toAlgebra. The assumed flatness and locality give Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom. Its FaithfulSMul instance and FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective give injectivity. No finiteness is used.

For s in S represent evalOneₐ(s) by b in B, lift its residue using hres to a residue in A/m_A and choose a representative a in A. Compatibility gives evalOneₐ(s - φhat(i_A(a))) = 0. Mathlib ker_evalOneₐ_eq_map and maximalIdeal_eq_map put this difference in maximalIdeal S. Thus composing φhat with the quotient by map φhat (maximalIdeal R) is surjective.

The Mathlib IsAdicComplete instance for the maximal-adic completion makes R precomplete for maximalIdeal R and S Hausdorff for maximalIdeal S. Rewrite the latter ideal using step 1. Apply Mathlib surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective to the quotient surjectivity from step 3. This theorem lifts residues by successive approximation in the complete source and uses separation of the target, requiring no finite-module hypothesis. Combine with step 2.

lean.statement:
theorem completion_map_bijective
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (hmax : Ideal.map φ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
    (hres : Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) φ
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap φ).ge))
    (φhat : AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A →+*
      AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B)
    (hcomp : φhat.comp (algebraMap A
      (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)) =
      (algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B)).comp φ)
    (hflat : φhat.Flat) : Function.Bijective φhat
